source_title: Jaishankar, Anita Anand agree that Modi’s Canada visit in December will be ‘another building block’
source_excerpt: Washington External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar met his Canadian counterpart Anita Anand and agreed that Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Canada in December will be another “building block” in ties between the two countries. story S. Jaishankar — a policy wonk among politicians Mr. Jaishankar met Ms. Anand in Atlanta on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting on Friday (October 30, 2026). Both the leaders also assessed the “steady growth” in India-Canada cooperation. External Affairs Minister Jaishankar in U.S. for G20 Foreign Ministers’ meet External Affairs Minister Jaishankar in U.S. for G20 Foreign Ministers’ meet The External Affairs Minister will participate in the two-day deliberations, which will begin with Mr. Rubio’s address on geopolitical issues External Affairs Minister Jaishankar in U.S. for G20 Foreign Ministers’ meet storyline 1 “Delighted to meet FM @AnitaAnandMP of Canada today. Assessed the steady growth of our cooperation,” Jaishankar said in a post on X on Friday (October 30, 2026). According to an official statement, “the ministers agreed that Prime Minister Modi’s visit to Canada in December will be another building block in the two countries’ ambitious relationship.” They also “agreed” to stay in close contact ahead of the visit, it said. Earlier this month, during her visit to India, Canadian Foreign Minister Anand met Prime Minister Modi, and she said they had a productive discussion on further strengthening India-Canada ties in trade, technology and energy. On October 16, the Indian High Commission in Ottawa said Mr. Modi will visit Canada on December 11 and 12. The date of the visit was also confirmed by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney. Mr. Carney had said he spoke to Modi and the visit will take place in Toronto and Ottawa. “We’ll see if we can broaden it out,” he said earlier this month. Mr. Jaishankar said he discussed trade, critical minerals, defence and nuclear cooperation, and multilateral issues with Quirno. The Minister said his meeting with Mexico’s Foreign Minister Roberto Velasco Alvarez was focused on giving a new impetus to bilateral relations. “A pleasure to sit down with FM Mauro Vieira of Brazil. Our conversation covered bilateral and global issues,” Mr. Jaishankar said. Mr. Jaishankar also met German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting. “Great to meet FM Johann Wadephul of Germany. Always look forward to my discussions with @AussenMinDE,” he said.
